issue.title: [KVM][warm reboot] syncd crashes during shutdown with double-free-corruption

failure.body:
[sonic_dump_vlab-01_20210120_172005.tar.gz](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/files/5844189/sonic_dump_vlab-01_20210120_172005.tar.gz)

**Description**
Tested Image: SONiC-OS-202012.5-264ecb18 on KVM switch, and  warm-reboot test leads to SYNCD crash.

There are multiple messages for missing OIDs in switch state map prior to the crash.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Continuous warm reboot test in KVM
2. DUT recovers after the crash.
3.

**Describe the results you received:**
```
Jan 14 <IPV6>.221771 vlab-01 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- ~SwitchState: begin
Jan 14 <IPV6>.221771 vlab-01 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- ~SwitchState: switch oid:0x2100000000
Jan 14 <IPV6>.221771 vlab-01 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- ~SwitchState: end
Jan 14 <IPV6>.238132 vlab-01 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- clean_after_switch_remove: cleaning metadata for switch: oid:0x2100000000
Jan 14 <IPV6>.263660 vlab-01 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- clean_after_switch_remove: removed all objects related to switch oid:0x2100000000
Jan 14 <IPV6>.265251 vlab-01 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- removeAllSwitches: removing switch RID oid:0x2100000000 took 7.503044 sec
Jan 14 <IPV6>.266023 vlab-01 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- run: calling api uninitialize
Jan 14 <IPV6>.266171 vlab-01 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- uninitialize: begin
Jan 14 <IPV6>.266318 vlab-01 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- uninitialize: stopping threads
Jan 14 <IPV6>.266523 vlab-01 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- stopUnittestThread: begin
Jan 14 <IPV6>.266858 vlab-01 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- unittestChannelThreadProc: exit VS unittest channel thread

Jan 14 <IPV6>.281354 vlab-01 WARNING syncd#syncd: message repeated 58 times: [ :- syncProcessEventPacket: oid oid:0x10000001f and it switch oid:0x2100000000 don't exists in switch state map]

Jan 14 <IPV6>.797548 vlab-01 NOTICE root: Finished warm shutdown syncd process ...
Jan 14 <IPV6>.931777 vlab-01 INFO syncd#supervisord 2021-01-14 <IPV6>,929 INFO exited: syncd (terminated by SIGABRT (core dumped); not expected)

Jan 14 <IPV6>.085997 vlab-01 DEBUG /container: container_stop: BEGIN
Jan 14 <IPV6>.092784 vlab-01 DEBUG /container: read_data: config:True feature:syncd fields:[('set_owner', 'local'), ('no_fallback_to_local', False)] val:['local', False]
Jan 14 <IPV6>.093828 vlab-01 DEBUG /container: read_data: config:False feature:syncd fields:[('current_owner', 'none'), ('remote_state', 'none'), ('container_id', '')] val:['none', 'none', '']
Jan 14 <IPV6>.095413 vlab-01 DEBUG /container: container_stop: syncd: set_owner:local current_owner:none remote_state:none docker_id:syncd
Jan 14 <IPV6>.935707 vlab-01 INFO syncd#supervisord 2021-01-14 <IPV6>,933 WARN received SIGTERM indicating exit request
Jan 14 <IPV6>.936418 vlab-01 INFO syncd#supervisord 2021-01-14 <IPV6>,935 INFO waiting for supervisor-proc-exit-listener, rsyslogd to die
Jan 14 <IPV6>.942039 vlab-01 INFO syncd#/supervisor-proc-exit-listener: Process syncd exited unxepectedly. Terminating supervisor...
Jan 14 <IPV6>.942578 vlab-01 INFO syncd#supervisord 2021-01-14 <IPV6>,942 WARN received SIGTERM indicating exit request
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
Crash free warm reboot.
